title: Find a Pinnacle Centre — claims and sources

claims.statement: Pinnacle starts with the everyday life the family wants the child to grow toward. Present abilities, relevant professional support, family-guided practice and review give each next step its direction.
claims.scope: Description of the Pinnacle life-first approach.
claims.limits: A direction for individual planning, not a promise of a particular outcome.

claims.statement: The public directory contains 62 published location records across 6 states or regions.
claims.scope: Count of location blocks reconciled into the dated directory.
claims.limits: A directory count does not establish current operation, ownership model, staffing, registration, opening hours or service availability.

claims.statement: 62 directory records link to centre-specific information pages, including location-status pages where applicable.
claims.scope: First-party destination coverage for the directory records.
claims.limits: A first-party profile is not independent endorsement and does not by itself establish the present service scope.

claims.statement: All 62 listed locations have a sourced Google Maps destination in this directory.
claims.scope: Presence of an external map destination in the reconciled source.
claims.limits: Google controls external place information. Ratings, reviews, hours, routes and map availability can change and are not copied or guaranteed here.

claims.statement: 53 listings contain at least one selected centre photograph and 58 contain a supplied centre emblem.
claims.scope: Media attached to the dated directory from the owner-supplied centre media set.
claims.limits: A photograph helps identify a place; it does not establish current condition, service availability, quality or outcome.

claims.statement: 9100 181 181 (telephone +919100181181) is the Pinnacle / Bharath Healthcare national guidance and appointment-enquiry number used throughout the directory.
claims.scope: Pinnacle-operated national contact and continuity route.
claims.limits: It is not a distinct branch number, government service, emergency service or diagnostic line.

claims.statement: 59 directory records match a current centre choice in the enrolment journey; other listings route families to the national team.
claims.scope: Public centre-choice matching for the existing enrolment journey.
claims.limits: Choosing a centre is a preference, not an accepted enquiry, confirmed appointment, professional or service.

claims.statement: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 is listed as non-diagnostic Class B developmental-support software for children aged 0–12.
claims.scope: Licensed software identity and functions recorded on the MD-5 evidence page.
claims.limits: The software licence does not diagnose a child, register every centre, establish branch service availability or guarantee an outcome.

note: Publication and source mapping do not prove discovery, indexing, ranking, AI citation, a connected call, an accepted enquiry, a centre visit or an outcome.
